name: Structured Programming
description: Learn C programming through control flow, functions, arrays, pointers, data structures, file handling, and advanced language features.

topics.name: Programming Fundamentals
topics.description: Write C programs using variables, input/output, operators, branching, and loops.

topics.name: Functions & Recursion
topics.description: Organize programs with functions and solve problems through recursion.

topics.name: Arrays & Strings
topics.description: Store, search, and manipulate multidimensional arrays and null-terminated C strings.

topics.name: Pointers & Dynamic Memory
topics.description: Use pointers and dynamic allocation to manage arrays, matrices, and memory safely.

topics.name: Structures & User-Defined Data Types
topics.description: Model data using structures, unions, enumerations, and type aliases; understand copying and memory layout.

topics.name: Files & Advanced C
topics.description: Read and write files, process command-line arguments, and organize persistent programs.

topics.name: Advanced C Programming
topics.description: Apply callbacks, variadic functions, bit operations, and preprocessing to advanced C problems.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Develop the mathematical foundations of computing through logic, proof, counting, discrete structures, and probability.

topics.name: Sets, Relations & Functions
topics.description: Describe sets, relations, and functions and analyze their properties.

topics.name: Logic & Mathematical Proof
topics.description: Express logical statements and construct valid mathematical arguments and proofs.

topics.name: Number Theory & Mathematical Induction
topics.description: Apply divisibility, modular arithmetic, and induction to integer problems.

topics.name: Counting & Combinatorics
topics.description: Solve counting problems using permutations, combinations, and combinatorial principles.

topics.name: Recurrence & Generating Functions
topics.description: Model sequences with recurrence relations and solve counting problems with generating functions.

topics.name: Graphs & Trees
topics.description: Analyze graphs, trees, partial orders, and their fundamental algorithms.

topics.name: Probability, Algebra & Advanced Topics
topics.description: Explore probability, algebraic structures, and asymptotic reasoning for computing.

name: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Design object-oriented software in C++ and Java using abstraction, inheritance, generic programming, collections, and concurrency.

topics.name: OOP Fundamentals
topics.description: Model programs with classes and objects, encapsulate state, and manage object lifecycles.

topics.name: Inheritance & Polymorphism
topics.description: Build class hierarchies and distinguish overloading, overriding, and forms of polymorphism.

topics.name: Virtual Functions & Abstraction
topics.description: Design abstract contracts and use virtual dispatch and interfaces.

topics.name: Operator Overloading & Object Copy
topics.description: Implement operators and correct object copying for classes that manage resources.

topics.name: Templates, STL & Exception Handling
topics.description: Write generic C++ code with templates and STL and handle exceptional conditions.

topics.name: Java OOP & Collections
topics.description: Apply Java object-oriented concepts, generics, and collection APIs.

topics.name: Java Advanced Programming
topics.description: Build Java programs with threads, synchronization, file streams, and network sockets.
